points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 杜甫出生于河南巩县，他的早年生活在这里度过。他在这里接受了儒家教育，并开始接触诗歌。杜甫的诗歌在这个时期开始展现出对社会现实的关注和对人民苦难的同情。
points.descriptionEn: Du Fu was born in Gongxian, Henan. His early life was spent here, where he received Confucian education and began to engage with poetry. During this time, Du Fu's poetry began to show his concern for social reality and sympathy for the sufferings of the people.

points.title: 成都时期
points.description: 杜甫在安史之乱后流亡至成都，在这里他建立了草堂。这一时期，他创作了大量反映社会现实和个人情感的诗歌，如《春望》和《茅屋为秋风所破歌》。成都时期是杜甫诗歌创作的黄金时期，他的诗歌风格逐渐成熟。
points.descriptionEn: After the An Lushan Rebellion, Du Fu fled to Chengdu, where he established the Thatched Cottage. During this period, he produced a large number of poems reflecting social reality and personal emotions, such as 'Spring View' and 'The Thatched Cottage Destroyed by Autumn Wind'. The Chengdu period was the golden age of Du Fu's poetry, and his style gradually matured.

points.title: 长沙时期
points.description: 杜甫在长沙期间，继续他的诗歌创作，并开始接触佛教思想。他在这里创作了《登高》等著名诗作。长沙时期，杜甫的诗歌更加深刻地反映了社会的不公和人民的苦难。
points.descriptionEn: During his time in Changsha, Du Fu continued his poetry writing and began to be influenced by Buddhist thought. Here, he wrote famous poems such as 'Ascending a High Tower'. The Changsha period saw Du Fu's poetry reflecting more deeply on the injustice of society and the sufferings of the people.

points.title: 岳阳时期
points.description: 杜甫在岳阳期间，他的健康状况恶化，但他的诗歌创作并未停止。他在这里创作了《登岳阳楼》等作品。岳阳时期，杜甫的诗歌更加注重个人情感和自然景观的描绘。
points.descriptionEn: During his time in Yueyang, Du Fu's health deteriorated, but his poetry creation did not stop. Here, he wrote works such as 'Ascending the Yueyang Tower'. The Yueyang period saw Du Fu's poetry focusing more on personal emotions and the depiction of natural landscapes.

points.title: 晚年生活
points.description: 杜甫在长沙度过了他的晚年，他的健康状况持续恶化。在生命的最后几年，他创作了《月夜忆舍弟》等作品。杜甫的晚年生活充满了贫困和疾病，但他对诗歌的贡献和影响是深远的。
points.descriptionEn: Du Fu spent his later years in Changsha, where his health continued to deteriorate. In the last years of his life, he wrote works such as 'Remembering My Younger Brother on the Night of the Moon'. Du Fu's later life was filled with poverty and illness, but his contribution and influence on poetry were profound.

appraisal.zh: 杜甫被尊为「诗圣」，其诗以深厚的社会内容与艺术成就著称，广泛反映唐代社会，尤以同情民生疾苦、批判社会不公见长，被史学界视为唐代最伟大的诗人之一，对后世影响深远，在流行文化中更成为忧国忧民、关注现实的诗人符号。也有研究者指出，他的诗有时过于聚焦个人情感，对自然与宇宙的探索不足，形式上亦偶显拘谨，限制了艺术表现力。
appraisal.en: Du Fu is honored as the 'Sage of Poetry,' celebrated for his profound social content and artistic achievement; his poems mirror Tang society and are especially noted for sympathy with the people's suffering and criticism of injustice. Historians regard him as one of the greatest Tang poets, deeply influential on later generations, and in popular culture he symbolizes concern for country and people. Yet some researchers note that his poetry can dwell too much on personal feeling, with little exploration of nature or the cosmos, and that its form is at times constrained, limiting its expressiveness.

supporter.zh: 杜甫被誉为‘诗圣’，他的诗歌以其深刻的社会内容和艺术成就而著称。他的作品反映了唐代社会的各个方面，尤其是对人民苦难的同情和对社会不公的批判。
supporter.en: Du Fu is hailed as the 'Sage of Poetry,' known for his profound social content and artistic achievements. His works reflect all aspects of Tang Dynasty society, particularly his sympathy for the sufferings of the people and his criticism of social injustice.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为杜甫的诗歌过于关注个人情感，缺乏对自然和宇宙的探索。此外，他的诗歌在形式上有时过于拘谨，限制了其艺术表现力。
critic.en: Some critics argue that Du Fu's poetry is overly focused on personal emotions, lacking exploration of nature and the cosmos. Additionally, his poetry is sometimes too拘谨 in form, limiting its artistic expressiveness.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，杜甫被视为唐代最伟大的诗人之一，他的诗歌对后世产生了深远的影响。在流行文化中，杜甫被符号化为一个代表忧国忧民、关注社会现实的诗人形象。
objective.en: In the historical academia, Du Fu is regarded as one of the greatest poets of the Tang Dynasty, with his poetry having a profound impact on posterity. In popular culture, Du Fu is symbolized as a poet representing concern for the country and the people, and his focus on social reality.

self.zh: 文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作。
self.en: Articles are written for the times, and songs and poems are written for events.
